theme: release pointer SYMLINK READLINK ISLINK STAT HUMANSIZE BASE64 promote

weaknesses.title: SYMLINK has no force/replace — promote needs RM first (TOCTOU)
weaknesses.detail: Second SYMLINK soft-fails if link exists (OK=0 SYMLINK_N=0). Board RM then SYMLINK opens a race: concurrent reader can see missing current. No atomic rename-over-symlink helper.
weaknesses.repro: SYMLINK tgt link twice → second OK=0

weaknesses.title: STAT follows symlinks; no STAT_ISLINK — dual ISLINK required
weaknesses.detail: STAT on current reports KIND=1 ISFILE=1 SIZE=target bytes. Agents cannot tell alias from real plate without separate SYS ISLINK. Easy to treat pointer as durable file.

weaknesses.title: HUMANSIZE floors integer units — precision loss for inventory
weaknesses.detail: 1536 bytes → 1K (drops 512B). 1023→1023B vs 1024→1K cliff. Agents comparing labels mis-rank near thresholds.

weaknesses.title: WRITE plate fragments omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: ROOT/ACTIVE/CURRENT/VAL/META glue in cat -A. Report bags use newlines via PUSH but path metas do not.

weaknesses.title: BASE64 standard alphabet only — no URL-safe variant
weaknesses.detail: Transport stamps with +/ may break path/query embedding. Agents invent ad-hoc tr maps.

weaknesses.title: READLINK returns stored target not realpath
weaknesses.detail: Relative symlink targets resolve only relative to link dir; plate stores raw string. No READLINK -f / REALPATH-of-link combo.

weaknesses.title: RM on symlink unlinks alias only — good but easy to confuse with release delete
weaknesses.detail: Demote drops current; version dir remains. Agents may assume RM CURRENT removes staged release tree.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_RP_REQUIRE=abc leaves REQUIRE_HIT=0; soft miss stays rc 0.

workarounds: RM current before SYMLINK; accept race or LOCKFILE promote critical section
Always ISLINK then STAT for pointer vs body distinction
Keep raw SIZE/HUMANSIZE_BYTES for compare; labels for display only
Prefer BASE64 for opaque body plates not path leaves
REALPATH after READLINK when absolute identity needed
language_gaps: STAT_ISLINK or STAT_KIND=symlink without follow mode
issues_faced: SYMLINK no-force + STAT-follow dual probe are sharp promote footguns
